targets: Exact top-level name string, {name}, {id}, or {path:[group,child,...]}. Group/ungroup/delete use top-level names. Use strings for objects created earlier in the same batch.
batch: Each operation is {action,params}. Use unique request_id; identical retry returns receipt without repeating writes. Preflight rejects invalid requests before writes. COM writes are not atomic; inspect any partial_or_uncertain result. Optional checkpoint_path saves a new backup before writes. One save at batch end.

kinds.shape: left,top,width,height; shape_type defaults rectangle; accepts Office numeric ID 1..200 or rectangle/rounded_rectangle/ellipse/triangle/diamond/hexagon/right_arrow

group.note: At least two unique names. Noncontiguous existing objects require explicit allow_z_order_change=true.

delete.note: confirm must be true. This is an API guard, not an additional user approval requirement for an already authorized deletion.

gradient.note: kind linear(default),radial,corner. angle 0..360 for linear. 2..64 strictly increasing stops from position 0 to 1. Each stop has position,color, optional transparency.

nodes.note: Inspect nodes first. Native 1-based indices include Bezier handles. Indices renumber after insert/delete/segment conversion. Coordinates follow PowerPoint's native node coordinate system; inspect grouped/rotated objects before edits. Auto/smooth handles may move adjacent nodes. Consolidate sequential edits of one path in a single operation.

rich_text.note: Only native text frames, not equations, table cells or SmartArt. Offsets are zero-based Unicode code points (emoji counts as one); adapter handles Office UTF-16. Range replacements preserve untouched runs and paragraph boundaries. Superscript/subscript use baseline +/- fractions. Unspecified font properties inherit native formatting.

modes.replace_ranges: edits:[{start,length,runs:[{text,font}]}]; nonoverlapping, cannot remove paragraph breaks; length 0 inserts.
modes.set_paragraphs: paragraphs:[{runs:[{text,font}],alignment,space_before,space_after,line_spacing,bullet,level}]. All paragraph formatting fields optional. alignment left/center/right/justify. level 1..9. Native SpaceWithin semantics for line_spacing.

font_fields.name: Latin font
font_fields.hyperlink: URL string or empty to clear

limits: Windows desktop Microsoft PowerPoint and pywin32 required; no WPS or macOS guarantee.
Concurrent manual changes can invalidate guards. Partial writes require inspection; no automatic rollback.
No Scientific Illustrator runtime or code dependency. Comparative benchmarks require a separately installed competitor only in the benchmark harness.
